title: GPU YUV->RGB shader hard-codes BT.601 for a BT.709 video stream
expected_finding: the decoder reports the stream as BT.709 limited range, but fsMain decodes the Y/U/V planes with BT.601 limited-range coefficients (1.596 Cr, -0.392 Cb, -0.813 Cr, 2.017 Cb instead of 1.793, -0.213, -0.533, 2.112): chroma is shifted
